text: A muscular male figure with fair skin, appearing late teens to early twenties. Long, blonde hair in a thick braid over one shoulder. Square face with heavy makeup: dark eyes, defined brows, pale lips. Wears a tight black leather-like corset top with gold circular accents and fringe, matching shorts. Black boots.
